description: Low-pass gate — envelope, low-pass filter and VCA in one

params.text: The length and basic shape of the envelope; turning it up lengthens the minimum gate and both the rise and the fall together
Rescales the response knob for longer envelopes
Curves the rising segment of the envelope
Curves the falling segment of the envelope
How much of the envelope reaches the filter cutoff, -100% to +100%
The filter cutoff with the envelope off, 0 to 20000Hz
How much of the envelope reaches the VCA, -100% to +100%
The VCA level with the envelope off
The VCA linear in amplitude instead of in decibels

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over the response, attenuated by the RESPONSE knob
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the filter's cutoff bias
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to the VCA's level bias
A rising edge fires the envelope; the channels patched here set the polyphony
The signal to be filtered and then amplified

outputs.text: The signal after the filter and the VCA

menu: LPF poles — the slope of the low-pass filter: 1, 2, 3 or 4
